mapper.insert: insert into deploy_artifact (app_id, version, file_name, file_path, file_size, md5, uploader) values (#{appId}, #{version}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{md5}, #{uploader})
mapper.select: select id, app_id, version, file_name, file_path, file_size, md5, uploader, create_time, update_time, deleted from deploy_artifact where deleted = 0 and app_id = #{appId} and version = #{version} order by id desc limit 1
